entries.234c319087a47128: This business installs and sells insulation for buildings such as condominiums, hospitals, schools, office buildings, factories, data centers and refrigerated warehouses. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥9,896 million.

entries.2aa70017c6b8498b: A company headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, that develops, sells and installs spray-applied rigid urethane foam insulation. It operates a single business of thermal insulation work and related operations; it does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and as of December 31, 2025, the number of employees was 710. It is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.36ecc1716e45d39c: This business installs and sells the polyurea-based waterproofing material 'Aqua Hajikun' on roofs and balconies of detached houses and on rooftops of buildings, among other locations. It entered the waterproofing market in September 2020. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,515 million.
